data.name: lichess-2013-01-prefix-human-small
data.selection: First 12 complete Rated Classical game or Rated Blitz game records with Termination Normal and numeric WhiteElo/BlackElo in the first 140000 decompressed bytes of the first 1048576 compressed bytes; BOT titles excluded. PGN records retained verbatim except LF separators.
data.humanProvenance: Public rated player games from the standard Lichess database, not puzzles or model self-play. No independent anti-cheat or identity audit.
data.ratings: Lichess Glicko2 values in original WhiteElo/BlackElo tags; not FIDE Elo or a calibration of Maia conditioning inputs.
limitations: Tiny chronological convenience sample, not representative or rating balanced.
2013 data may overlap Maia training; this is not a held-out benchmark.
No universal Elo, human-likeness, or playing-strength claim.
